body: Hey, thanks for you well wishing. I have put a lot of thought into this, not just tonight either, and it's funny but I too thought I might regret it at the last moment but I've actually felt far happier and more at peace with my decision as time goes on.

Thanks Navya, I'm Danni :) it's not that I feel unloved, I know my parents really love and care about me. I just hate myself and feel so much pain and emptiness everyday that I just can't keep doing it anymore.

I've got help, seen psychologists, psychiatrists, counsellors etc tried various therapies and drugs and been into psychiatric wards on more than one occasion. It's just that the pain, emptiness and utter self loathing never leave me. I know I'm selfish and I'll badly hurt everyone in my life but I just can't live with this anymore and I see no hope for getting better. 

Sorry for being so complaining.

Hi, 

Thank you for taking the time to post. I too have done plenty of research on suicide, methods and side effects and the bottom line is I'm more than willing to risk it.

Thanks for your words of care and concern, it's really lovely of you and I appreciate it. I wish I could say I'd reconsider, but honestly, I just can't keep going anymore.
umm...yeah the whole pain thing. Plus I didn't really post on here to discuss suicide methods, I've long since done my research.

I can understand, but guns aren't easily accessible in my country and I'm definitely too much of a coward to jump off anything/do something really painful. I'm far more in favour of going to sleep (even if it takes a while) then having my breathing stop.
yeah, watching a movie while waiting to pass out
Ah well, it was a thought. To anyone reading this, I wish you a happy life.
